ideas.pitch: A static and dynamic analysis tool designed to inspect Signal Protocol implementations for common cryptographic implementation flaws, weak PRNG seeds, and key-leakage vectors.
ideas.problem_statement: Secure Communication Protocol: Could you spot a weakened random-number generator or a quietly leaked key hidden in thousands of lines of code?
ideas.title: SignalAudit: Automated Cryptographic Side-Channel and Implementation Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly attacks the core cybersecurity evaluation criteria of Protocol Zero by finding the exact implementation bugs (like weak RNGs and side-channels) that judges from IIT Madras and IIITDM will be testing against your code.

ideas.pitch: An encrypted off-grid mesh messaging client running on ESP32/LoRa hardware implementing a lightweight variant of the Double Ratchet algorithm with post-quantum lattice-based key exchange.
ideas.problem_statement: Secure Communication Protocol: Could you build a messaging system that holds up even when someone is actively trying to break it?
ideas.title: MeshGuard: Post-Quantum LoRa Secure Mesh Messaging Protocol
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical/hardware-level secure networking with advanced applied cryptography, showing extreme technical depth that stands out in an attack-defense oriented hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A security monitoring daemon that sits between messaging clients and transport layers to detect session state divergence, out-of-order skipped key exhaustion, and active MITM tampering in Signal-like protocols.
ideas.problem_statement: Secure Communication Protocol: Break Vulnerabilities. Engineer Trust. Secure Communication Protocol Zero focuses on the security of modern communication systems.
ideas.title: RatchetHound: Real-Time Double Ratchet State Leakage & MITM Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Simulates the exact threat vectors evaluated during the final Attack-Defence CTF phase, providing proactive telemetry for secure messaging integrity.

ideas.pitch: A secure communication layer that uses Zero-Knowledge proofs to verify that participants have securely purged past session keys and ephemeral secrets without revealing message contents.
ideas.problem_statement: Secure Communication Protocol: Billions of messages are protected every day by end-to-end encryption. But what happens when the cryptography is sound and the code around it is not?
ideas.title: ZeroTrace: Verifiable Ephemeral Key Exchange Protocol with ZK Audits
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings cutting-edge cryptographic guarantees (ZK-proofs for secure state erasure) to classical E2EE protocols, matching the rigorous applied cryptography focus of the bootcamp.

ideas.pitch: An automated code-auditing pipeline that flags suspicious bitwise manipulation, hidden backdoors, and hardcoded entropy reduction routines introduced into cryptographic libraries.
ideas.problem_statement: Secure Communication Protocol: A six-week challenge focused on secure implementation, backdoor design and backdoor detection.
ideas.title: BackdoorDetector: ML-Assisted AST Diffing for Cryptographic Backdoors
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the explicit 'backdoor detection' sub-theme of the hackathon with a working, demonstrable static analysis engine.
